question: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number of orders, total sales amount, and the name and sales amount of all sales representatives who achieved the highest total sales amount in that region (include all representatives in case of a tie).
sql:
WITH region_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        r.id AS region_id,
        r.name AS region_name,
        sr.id AS sales_rep_id,
        sr.name AS sales_rep_name,
        COUNT(o.id) AS order_count,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS total_sales
    FROM web_region r
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON sr.region_id = r.id
    JOIN web_accounts a ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_orders o ON o.account_id = a.id
    GROUP BY r.id, r.name, sr.id, sr.name
),
region_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        region_id,
        region_name,
        SUM(order_count) AS total_orders,
        SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales_amount
    FROM region_sales
    GROUP BY region_id, region_name
),
top_sellers AS (
    SELECT 
        region_id,
        region_name,
        sales_rep_id,
        sales_rep_name,
        total_sales,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_id ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS rnk
    FROM region_sales
)
SELECT 
    rs.region_name,
    rs.total_orders,
    ROUND(rs.total_sales_amount, 2) AS total_sales_amount,
    ts.sales_rep_name,
    ROUND(ts.total_sales, 2) AS sales_rep_total_sales
FROM region_summary rs
JOIN top_sellers ts ON ts.region_id = rs.region_id AND ts.rnk = 1
ORDER BY rs.region_name, ts.sales_rep_name
